snippet.title: JIN - MULTIPLAYER BOARD GAME DEVELOPED BY NIPSAPP GAME STUDIOS
snippet.description:
JIN is a traditional-inspired strategy board game built around clean rules, deep tactics, and satisfying mind games.

Move your pieces across the board, combine them to increase their value, and capture your opponent by landing with equal or lower strength. Every turn is a puzzle, and one mistake can flip the entire match.

With simple controls and a calm aesthetic, JIN is easy to learn in minutes, but rewards players who think ahead, set traps, and master positioning.

Key Features
Tactical board strategy with fast, turn-based gameplay

Move orthogonally or diagonally and plan every step

Combine your own pieces by stacking to create stronger values

Capture enemy stacks using smart positioning and value control

Unique neutral zone rules that create interesting mid-board tension

Play to win by capturing key pieces or reaching the score limit

Minimal, relaxing presentation with deep competitive strategy

JIN is designed for players who love pure strategy, clean design, and games where skill matters more than luck.

Download from STEAM STORE - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4416160/JIN/
Download from APP STORE - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/jin-multiplayer-board-game/id6759051301
